name: Tatewaki Satoru
source:
Shiima's stepfather and a priest of the Marenis religion.
He also serves on the board of directors at Marenis High School.

"I'm looking forward to this year's Marenis Festival."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=15]official website[/url]]
